parts.desc: 远程分支保存协作者已推送的提交
parts.desc_en: The remote branch contains commits collaborators have pushed

parts.desc: 将新提交下载到本地仓库，不修改工作目录文件
parts.desc_en: Downloads remote commits and updates remote-tracking references without changing working-tree files

parts.desc: 获取的提交先保存于本地仓库，等待合并或变基
parts.desc_en: Fetched commits remain separate until you merge or rebase them.

parts.desc: 将获取的提交整合到当前分支，此时可能发生冲突
parts.desc_en: Integrates fetched commits into the current branch; conflicts may occur here

parts.desc: 合并完成后，工作目录更新为当前分支的文件版本
parts.desc_en: After integration, the working tree reflects the updated current branch

variants.when: 先确认工作区，再和远程对齐
variants.when_en: Check local changes before bringing in remote updates

variants.when: 获取远程更新，但暂不合并到当前分支
variants.when_en: Get remote updates, but don't merge them into the current branch yet

variants.when: 看到这句说明本地已是最新
variants.when_en: This message means your current branch already matches the remote

use.t: 开始协作前先取得网上的最新版本，减少之后的冲突
Pull 前先查看当前状态，保存或收好未完成改动
第一次取得仓库用{c:clone}，之后同步新增版本再用 Pull
完成后运行项目，确认新版本在本机仍然正常

dont.t: 手头有混乱的半成品时直接 Pull，把两批改动搅在一起
遇到冲突就随意选择一边，而不理解双方修改
每次想更新都重新 Clone，制造多个重复项目文件夹
把 Pull 当成恢复工具；它不能找回从未 Commit 的本地改动

lessonPractice.title: 同事已把修复推到远端，但你本地还有未完成改动。怎样同步更安全？

options.label: 先查看状态并提交或贮藏本地改动，再 Pull，解决冲突后运行检查
options.feedback: 先收好本地现场能分清两批变化，拉取后的冲突和运行结果也都有明确验收。

options.label: 直接 Pull，让 Git 自动决定未完成改动该保留哪一边
options.feedback: Git 不能理解业务意图，混合现场会增加冲突和误选内容的风险。

options.label: 每次远端更新都重新 Clone 一个“项目-最新版”文件夹
options.feedback: 重复项目会分散本地改动和环境，已有仓库应通过 Pull 同步新版本。

en.title: A teammate pushed a fix, but your local project still has unfinished changes. How can you synchronize safely?

options.label: Inspect status, commit or stash local work, pull, resolve conflicts, and run checks
options.feedback: Securing local work separates the change sets, while conflict resolution and checks verify the merged result.

options.label: Pull immediately and let Git decide which unfinished changes to keep
options.feedback: Git cannot understand business intent, and mixing an unfinished workspace increases conflict and wrong-choice risk.

options.label: Clone a new project-latest folder whenever the remote repository changes
options.feedback: Duplicate projects scatter local work and environments; an existing repository should synchronize with Pull.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先运行 git status，说明本地未完成改动，并在我确认后选择 Commit 或 Stash。工作区干净后 Pull 最新分支，冲突逐项解释，最后运行项目检查；不要重新 Clone 或自动覆盖一边。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Run git status first and explain unfinished local work, then commit or stash only after confirmation. Pull once clean, explain conflicts individually, and run project checks. Do not reclone or automatically choose one side.

entry.demoDetail:
网上的项目比电脑多 2 个新版本
下载并接上新版本pull→
我的电脑已经更新到最新
git pull

Pull 用在“电脑里已经有这个项目”之后：它把网上新增的版本取回，再接到你当前的版本线上。操作前先保存或收好手头改动。

en.demoDetail:
Remote repositoryTwo commits ahead of your local branch
Fetch and integrate commitspull→
Local repositoryNow up to date
git pull

Use pull when the repository already exists on your computer and you need remote commits. Git fetches them and integrates them into your current branch. Commit or stash local changes first if they could conflict.

use.t: Update a local branch from its remote
Bring remote changes into a clean working state

dont.t: Pull without checking which branch is active
Use it with unresolved local changes
Assume it only downloads files without integrating
Resolve resulting conflicts by blindly choosing one side

usageMocks.pull-vs-clone:
clone首次：复制工作文件与仓库历史
pull后续：获取并整合远程更新
usageMocks.pull-conflict: $ git pullAuto-merging index.htmlCONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in index.html拉取后也可能发生冲突，需要手动解决
usageMocks.pull-never-bad:
队友已推 12 个新提交本地仍是旧版本
长期不同步远端，会扩大分支差异并增加合并冲突
usageMocks.pull-ignore-bad:
Automatic merge failed;fix conflicts and then commit the result.(main|MERGING) $ 冲突尚未处理
仓库会保持合并中状态，后续操作前应先完成或中止合并
usageMocks.pull-blind-bad:
pull 后有 3 个文件变化未检查改动
继续修改可能覆盖协作者已经完成的工作
usageMocks.pull-undelete-bad:
$ git pullAlready up to date.未保存到 Git 历史的改动不会被取回
git pull 无法恢复从未提交到 Git 的本地改动
